Hi Evan — great to hear and glad the demo was useful. Attaching a draft proposal (VAS_3yr_proposal_v1.xlsx) and a short pricing explainer (redwood_stepdown_pricing_v1.pdf). High level:

- We can support a stepdown-credit model tied to your phased ramp. Typical structure we recommend for this profile:
  * Year 1 (30% capacity): 18% prepay discount on committed units
  * Year 2 (50% capacity): 12% prepay discount
  * Year 3 (100% capacity): 8% prepay discount

- Credits are issued at invoice time and amortize monthly across the year they are purchased; unused credits can be carried forward up to 12 months, after which remaining balance converts to a 60-day credit hold before expiry (we can negotiate longer carry windows for enterprise contracts).

- Breakpoints: discounts scale with effective commit size; e.g., >$1M ARR equivalent gives an extra +2% on each tier.

Attached files: VAS_3yr_proposal_v1.xlsx (breakdown by GPU pool, TPM, monthly amortization example), redwood_stepdown_pricing_v1.pdf (narrative + worked example).

If the team prefers a simpler approach we can also offer a flat 15% across a 3-year full prepay (no staircase). Which would you prefer for procurement to review?

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
